automation_status: Reviewed eligibility rules for workers. Dependency entry proposals and qualified code-entry reference propagation are native; the remaining rules are coordinator guidance, not a general automatic propagation or acceptance engine.

requires: Pinned call targets identify a specific inherited/base operation, not merely a shared implementation guess.
Current class declarations confirm the receiver's inheritance path and which derived kinds override the operation.
The original selector/default cases and target-table data are independently bounded.
rules.action: Write the explicit qualified base call for the cases whose pinned target is that base operation; retain derived overrides, selector order, default behavior and table data.
contraindications: A matching callee name without target identity is insufficient.
Do not turn inherited no-op cases into new behavior or reorder the switch.
rules.reopen_when: New pinned target or caller evidence contradicts the qualified operation mapping, or a fresh production-object comparison exposes a different selector/data interpretation.

requires: Pinned accesses and current member declarations agree on object size, field offsets and initialized values.
The allocation site and initialization sequence belong to one object lifetime, and the call graph identifies the corresponding operation.
The typed construction preserves the original allocation-failure path, store order, rereads and post-call effects.
rules.action: Represent an observed object initialization as a genuine constructor and typed new-expression instead of raw storage plus duplicated member stores, only when all lifetime and failure-path predicates hold.
contraindications: Do not infer nominal historical class identity from a size or mangled name alone.
Do not alter allocator, null handling, insertion order or compiler policy to obtain the result.
rules.reopen_when: New original lifetime/caller evidence changes initialization order, allocation semantics or which object owns the fields.

requires: The source reader reports ambiguity caused by duplicate body attribution within the same actual source file.
The remaining definition is uniquely selected by the real declaration and current compiled source ownership.
A before/after annotation audit proves mapping identity, span, mode, claim and implementation text are unchanged.
rules.action: Remove just the redundant body-location fact through the source writer; do not remove the original identity or weaken mapping/reference checks.
contraindications: Do not use this to resolve cross-file or genuinely overloaded ambiguity.
Do not interpret a debug-line-only object delta as a general preservation pass.
rules.reopen_when: A new overload, source move or reader change means the remaining source attribution is no longer uniquely grounded.

requires: Pinned callers retain real calls to the identified provider; current COFF embeds its operations instead.
The complete provider can move intact to a separate same-recipe source unit, preserving public declarations, original identities and owned data.
Every affected constructor, standalone provider and other consumer is included in the comparison.
rules.action: Test removal of unintended same-TU provider visibility. In the witnessed Sound change, moving set_type/get_type OUT of sound.cpp restored external calls in constructors; it did not make those providers inline.
contraindications: Do not add inline/noinline attributes or global optimization changes as substitutes for source ownership evidence.
Do not infer a historical filename or whole-TU boundary from one restored inline.
Do not treat co-location or outlining as universally beneficial; the direction of original call visibility must be observed.
rules.reopen_when: Fresh COFF shows the provider still does not inline, collateral losses appear, or new ownership/caller evidence changes the justified cohort.

requires: Pinned init/exit code identifies a storage receiver and paired constructor/destructor behavior.
Current COFF init/fini relocations and linked table entries independently identify the same real object; do not infer local symbol identity from ordinal alone.
A declaration after the actual definition is proven redundant and the rebuilt object confirms exactly one lifetime pair.
rules.action: Keep genuine object storage and compiler-generated lifetime operations with the evidenced owner; remove only the proven duplicate post-definition declaration that causes duplicate emission.
contraindications: Never author fake init/fini callbacks or claim full CRT order from a bounded subsequence.
Do not remove declarations without the physical duplicate-pair evidence.
rules.reopen_when: Fresh physical symbols show multiple or missing lifetime pairs, or new pinned CRT entries contradict the bounded order.

evidence.witness: src/caviar.cpp: set_camera_direct ORIGINAL/LEVER/TRIED annotation and current typed member accesses; commit bff2dd701

requires: Pinned instructions show distinct scalar stores and exact offsets rather than a bulk copy.
Typed members and static layout evidence prove each source/destination element correspondence.
Guard order, null behavior, operand order and all element stores are preserved.
rules.action: Use explicit typed element assignments when struct assignment or memcpy demonstrably emits a different access sequence under the production recipe.
contraindications: Do not generalize from one matrix or copy width; do not use raw `this + offset` aliases to force the bytes.
No mangled catalogue spelling alone establishes the pointer or aggregate type.
rules.reopen_when: New layout/caller evidence changes element mapping, or production COFF no longer shows the measured aggregate-versus-scalar distinction.

requires: Pinned construction site identifies initialization after successful storage allocation.
The constructor is nonvirtual and its full body/base/member closure has no operation that can throw.
Allocation failure and post-construction failure paths remain outside the constructor and are preserved.
rules.action: Model the observed initialization as a genuine constructor; use a nonthrowing contract only when body and closure justify it, while keeping allocation and legacy failure behavior unchanged.
contraindications: Do not add a nonthrowing contract to a virtual method with unproven derived implementers.
Do not call the contract recovered original spelling or use it to normalize allocation failure.
rules.reopen_when: New bases, members, callbacks, virtual overrides or throwing operations enter the constructor closure.

evidence.witness: recovery/COMPILER_EVIDENCE.md, Source-form experiments after structure; pinned Sprite::change_color at 0x005EAD9F

requires: A failed function contains a distinctive repeated/loop opcode, but no source-level CFG and dataflow explanation has yet been established.
rules.action: Stop equivalent loop-spelling retries. First map complete control flow, register lifetimes, unrolled operations and memory effects; retain ordinary C++ recovery obligations.
contraindications: Do not infer that C++ matching is impossible or introduce assembly from LOOP presence.
rules.reopen_when: New pinned instruction-level evidence identifies a distinct source construct or a faithful compiler-supported structural model not covered by prior trials.

requires: Pinned signed compare/branch and source dataflow establish a signed loop counter; current code uses unsigned comparison.
rules.action: Correct the semantically wrong signedness when evidence supports it, then treat the rest of the function as a separate residual. Do not report a full match from one corrected branch.
contraindications: Do not cast or widen unrelated globals to coerce a mnemonic.
Do not treat the local signed correction as proof of prototype or class ABI.
rules.reopen_when: New evidence identifies the remaining call targets/register lifetimes or reveals that the signed range differs from the tested source model.

requires: A proposed change alters a compiler flag or pragma beyond the single evidenced owner.
rules.action: Distinguish /Oi intrinsic policy from /Ob inlining and inspect actual unit recipes. Test the complete affected cohort; a local gain never authorizes an unreviewed global flag/pragma change.
contraindications: A changed byte score in one function is not sufficient when the cohort loses other passes.
rules.reopen_when: A distinct source/compiler hypothesis or coherent ownership-policy change has new evidence; preserve any justified structural regression for explicit review/restoration instead of automatically reverting it.

evidence.report: recovery/COMPILER_EVIDENCE.md, Compiler identity before more spelling searches; .opensmacx/recovery/easy-wave-oct26bs/cpu-caviar-cohort-result.json

requires: A proposed fix changes CPU target policy for a Caviar body because of an x87/register residual, without new source-level operand or type evidence.
rules.action: Keep production CPU policy unchanged. Compare target source, recipe and compiler identity with the retained cohort before requesting any new policy experiment; prefer evidence-backed C++ structure under the current recipe.
contraindications: Do not generalize the cohort to other TUs or compiler versions.
Do not infer impossible matching from unchanged results.
rules.reopen_when: New pinned operand/dataflow evidence supports a distinct source model, or a genuinely different, independently qualified compiler context is proposed with a bounded no-loss control.

requires: A score-driven exception specification is proposed on a virtual API whose complete derived implementation surface is not known.
rules.action: Keep the original declaration contract until class hierarchy and external implementers are evidenced; prefer source ownership/call visibility fixes that do not narrow the virtual contract.
contraindications: A bounded native gain does not prove historical spelling or ABI compatibility.
rules.reopen_when: Complete current and external derived-class evidence establishes the contract and all virtual callers/overrides remain compatible.

requires: An original helper writes through caller output slots and the proposed source aliases a local to that output.
rules.action: Trace post-call uses and complete lifetimes of all output and position values before changing locals. Compare saved registers, stack frame, call arguments and helper behavior independently.
contraindications: Do not use volatile/dummy locals or change a shared helper used by other callers to manufacture a register spill.
rules.reopen_when: New original lifetime/type evidence explains the remaining spill or demonstrates that the helper mask is semantically redundant across every caller.

requires: An inline destructor exposes nested base/member cleanup in a caller.
Other pinned consumers also expand that destructor; source visibility is shared.
rules.action: Compare all affected consumer lifetime graphs before moving the definition. The FlatButton out-of-line control did not restore Console and removed five required DipEdit expansions; do not replay this global move as a solution.
contraindications: Raw FuncInfo counts are diagnostics, not semantic EH equivalence.
Scratch-slot equality does not prove object identity; trace saved receivers and predecessor states.
rules.reopen_when: New receiver/lifetime or TU/provider evidence supports a different model; no independent class change is justified solely by an EH count.

evidence.witness: docs/DECOMP_MAP.md, The source map; recovery/COMPILER_EVIDENCE.md, Constructor tables and intrinsic call boundaries

requires: A recovered catalogue decoration disagrees with the current symbol or declaration.
rules.action: Trace actual call/return use, constructor-selected tables, memory widths and signed operations. A stripped original does not authenticate recovered H/I or Q/U decorations.
contraindications: Do not rename symbols or change signedness/virtualness from catalogue spelling alone.
rules.reopen_when: Authenticated original symbols/debug data or independent instruction/caller evidence establishes the declaration.

requires: Candidate instruction scheduling differs before a reported relocation mismatch.
rules.action: Locate original and candidate instruction/operand boundaries separately, then resolve their actual targets. A candidate relocation offset can fall on a different original opcode; do not repair a correct binding to silence that diagnostic.
contraindications: Same callee sets alone do not prove instruction correspondence or whole-function equivalence.
rules.reopen_when: Aligned operand/target evidence identifies a real reference error.

requires: The archive bytes match the source-owned archive pin.
An already-bound complete executable contribution matches original bytes outside independently checked relocation operands.
The complete external function inventory has unique symbols at exact section-relative offsets; entries lie within that contribution.
rules.action: Run recover components propose-entries with the component, pinned image and local archive to generate and natively check the complete candidate entry inventory. Review the candidate against the whole component context before publishing through the source writer. Retain the whole contribution binding; do not fabricate per-function extents, application implementations or original symbol provenance.
contraindications: Address proximity and a familiar CRT name are insufficient.
An entry location does not prove callable ABI, complete relocation closure, original archive selection or final-link retention. Unknown prerequisites remain unknown.
rules.reopen_when: New archive, section, relocation-target or original-caller evidence changes the dependency interpretation.

requires: The referring code contribution is independently bounded and its non-relocation bytes match the pinned archive.
Corresponding COFF DIR32 and original PE HIGHLOW operands consistently identify one section base after subtracting symbol offsets and addends.
The complete ordinary raw-backed initialized data section matches the original bytes, with the full native symbol inventory and no internal relocations.
rules.action: Propose a full native ToolchainDataSectionBinding instead of inventing an application global or a per-symbol extent. Check all affected references together with wrong-base and wrong-symbol-offset controls.
contraindications: Initialized writable data proves startup contents, not immutable runtime state.
Do not apply to COMMON, BSS, TLS, COMDAT, relocation-bearing sections or disagreeing bases without separately supported evidence.
Do not label an initialized section as a virtual-zero data start, or treat unresolved cross-member provider routing as a pass.
rules.reopen_when: New archive, source, code/data relocation or provider-selection evidence changes the interpretation; remeasure the complete affected dependency cohort.

requires: Source owns the complete contribution boundaries and complete unique external function entry inventories under a pinned archive and image.
A seed contribution's boundary, bytes, references and entry inventory all pass the native verifier.
The consumer is a declared code contribution with a unique ordinary undefined external function symbol; no conflicting function, import, absolute or data interpretation is shadowed.
rules.action: Run the native component binary check across the complete declared family. It propagates independently qualified entry targets in bounded immutable rounds, allowing a passing leaf to qualify callers and their entries without function-local retries.
contraindications: Unknown parents and partially verified overlapping function bindings cannot bootstrap a cycle.

Do not derive target addresses from the operands being checked, route these entries through data or ordinary function checks, or infer ABI, independent extents, linker selection or application acceptance.
Do not reuse a cached verdict after its pinned inputs or source interpretations change.
rules.reopen_when: New source-owned contribution, entry, import, data or function evidence, or a different pinned archive/image, changes the reference closure; rerun the full affected dependency family.

requires: Pinned standalone provider code and expanded consumer instructions independently agree on operations, argument mapping and read/call order.
Pinned external callers and current compiled calls distinguish consumers that must retain real calls from those that require expansion.
The complete provider/consumer ownership group includes its labels, storage, associated compiler data and all affected historical claims.
rules.action: Co-locate the real providers and expanded consumers in a coherent source unit, keeping required external callers outside its definition visibility. Measure the complete group and its caller witnesses together under one justified TU recipe. Let the compiler propagate provider corrections to the shared uses.
contraindications: Source/address order alone does not fence optimization or prove a historical TU boundary. A duplicated arithmetic sequence alone is only a search hint.

Do not add noinline attributes, exports, dummy address-taking or register-pressure tricks to repair a mistaken ownership boundary. Explicit inline can elide a required standalone body; verify emission and every consumer.

Carry original data annotations and object ownership with the implementation. Type-evidence options must agree in production and measurement, with an executable-body control; they are not original compiler provenance or acceptance.
Preserve justified structural work and historical obligations when matching remains incomplete; do not call unknown preservation or data-extent prerequisites a pass.
rules.reopen_when: New original call, lifetime, data-layout, provider or TU evidence changes the consumer partition, or fresh native code shows a changed external caller or missing standalone emission.

requires: Pinned direct calls identify a standalone helper entry and its actual receiver; current class declarations agree with the receiver ownership.
A proposed header-inline or provider-visibility move changes where the helper can be emitted or expanded.
rules.action: Check the actual helper symbol and required call edges in fresh objects as well as all affected consumer bodies. In the witnessed Buffer/Spot header trial both required standalone entries disappeared and no measured cohort gained exact functions; keep their genuine owners and do not adopt that trial.
contraindications: A class satellite outside an inferred contribution core does not justify moving it to the caller class or claiming a historical inline header.
Do not force emission with exports, dummy address-taking or noinline attributes. An incomplete mapped-call census cannot prove absence of other callers.
rules.reopen_when: New original call/emission or source ownership evidence, or a relevant compiler/provider change, supports a distinct model that retains the required entry and consumers.

requires: Independent original accesses show both byte and word operations on the same evidenced storage.
A proposed typed mask, bitfield or union rewrite improves instruction count but changes access width or collateral consumers.
rules.action: Retain both the proven storage width and the original operation width as obligations. Compare the full original operands and all affected consumers; a word AND with 0xFFFE is not the observed byte AND with 0xFE, even when the instruction count agrees.
contraindications: Do not infer a historical union or bitfield declaration from overlapping accesses alone.
Do not promote shape equality, fewer instructions or a score improvement to byte equality, reference qualification or layout proof.
rules.reopen_when: New original alias/type/lifetime evidence or a distinct source/compiler model explains both widths without changing other required accesses.

requires: Complete compared instructions localize a residual and prior reports identify the tested body, compiler, recipe and visibility inputs.
The proposed retry repeats the same source hypothesis or the same policy sweep without new causal evidence.
rules.action: Skip the exhausted hypothesis and select another owner or investigate a distinct dependency. The witnessed callback return/break, explicit-this, continuation and reduced-TU trials did not fix the four register bytes; the Game/ReportIf CPU sweeps produced no gains. Keep the remaining matching obligations open.
contraindications: A reduced diagnostic TU does not prove every possible ownership arrangement irrelevant.
These bounded negatives do not establish impossible C++ matching, a historical CPU recipe, or results for unscored associated spans.
rules.reopen_when: Relevant source/header/provider, visibility/TU, compiler/recipe or original dataflow evidence changes; a new session alone does not reopen the hypothesis.

requires: Workers use the existing native source inventory cache and a trusted canonical absolute ignored shared directory.
Fresh current-source and Git history/claim continuity checks remain enabled; only pure parsing projections are cached.
rules.action: Set RECOVERY_PARSE_CACHE_DIR to the coordinator checkout shared .opensmacx/cache/parse before entering worker directories, and pass the same absolute value to every worker and verification subprocess. Batch compatible frozen recording selections to amortize history checks; perform real compilations and fresh verification as usual.
contraindications: Do not copy claim ledgers, replay acceptance reports, skip history traversal or assume a cached parse proves source freshness.
Do not derive the shared directory from each worker PWD or reuse compiler leases concurrently. Measured cache timings are bounded observations, not recovery-throughput guarantees.
rules.reopen_when: Cache format/trust boundaries, native parsing behavior or shared-directory configuration changes; delete the disposable cache if necessary and rerun fresh checks.

requires: An ownership move can renumber compiler-generated initialization/destruction symbols in the extracted and remaining source units.
Original entries, actual object receivers and fresh physical COFF/CRT relocations can distinguish each lifetime independently of generated name ordinals.
rules.action: Audit generated lifetimes in both the extracted owner and remaining TU. Resolve each current symbol from fresh physical receiver/call/CRT evidence and publish any binding changes through the guarded source writer, preserving original identities, complete spans and claims.
contraindications: Do not infer helper identity from a matching $E ordinal or fabricate initialization callbacks to preserve an old name.
A bounded lifetime subsequence does not prove complete global startup order, original filenames or a full historical TU boundary.

requires: A mapping has an explicit compile_context or multiple emitted inline/COMDAT copies.
A screen used the marker host object or has not established which current copy the mapping selects.
rules.action: Resolve the declared compilation context with the native source selector before diagnosing a body regression. Compare the selected physical object and, when claiming linked placement, qualify the actual linked provider separately. Seven destructor misses in the marker-host screen were already exact in their declared contexts; no C++ or recipe change was needed.
contraindications: Do not search copies for a convenient winner or silently rewrite compile_context.
A selected current provider does not establish the original historical TU or equality of all other emitted copies.
rules.reopen_when: Source ownership, explicit context, compiler recipe, emitted copies or linked selection changes; a disagreement in an unselected copy alone does not justify changing the selected body.

requires: A source move changes a compiler-generated local storage name.
Fresh physical COFF proves ordinary non-code storage with local storage class in the same emitting unit, and independent receiver/access evidence identifies the original object.
rules.action: Use the guarded source writer to express the evidenced TU-local object target. Keep original identity and spans fixed. Check both the extracted owner and remaining unit; identical local names in different objects need not denote the same storage.
contraindications: Never classify a target as local from its spelling or ordinal alone.
Do not make it globally routable, erase ambiguous cross-kind references or infer complete CRT order from a matching subsequence.
rules.reopen_when: Storage class, owner, physical accesses, generated lifetimes or linked selection changes.

requires: A fresh native measurement identifies currently matching implementations not yet recorded as byte claims.
Original identities, complete spans, current emitted contexts and source/body attribution remain intact.
rules.action: Batch eligible addresses through the native recorder under one frozen source epoch, inspect per-address publication even on a nonzero command exit, then freshly confirm the published set. In the witnessed batch, 204 claims were recorded across 81 owners without C++ statement changes; four explicit member-body attribution obligations stayed pending.
contraindications: Do not equate a new claim with a new implementation or strict reference-aware equality.
Do not delete a valid explicit body fact or move a correct inline definition to bypass unsupported attribution.
A partial recorder publication with exit 3 is not a successful whole request; inspect its diff and confirm winners freshly.
rules.reopen_when: New native member-body attribution support or actual ownership evidence resolves a pending case; source, compiler or image changes require fresh measurements.

evidence.witness: src/credits.cpp Credits::Credits at 0x00428780; pinned primary 0x00428780-0x00428830 and cleanup 0x00653110-0x0065315A; .opensmacx/recovery/credits-order-nov06bc/clear-deck.json; strict-constructor.json; .opensmacx/recovery/array-clear-propagation-nov06bd/game-trial.json and energy-trial.json

requires: Pinned construction calls and field stores independently establish whether each scalar/array reset occurs before or after nontrivial owned subobject construction.

Current declarations establish the same complete member layout, real scalar-array extent and zero representation; no raw-storage, inferred-tail, nontrivial-element or volatile-array substitution is involved.
A fresh production-object comparison localizes the residual; old source comments and historical byte claims are not current mismatch evidence.
rules.action: Keep genuine implicit base/member construction and place scalar resets in the constructor body when the original resets them after construction. Compare a typed indexed array clear with memset under the unchanged production recipe, preserving subsequent store order and every neighbor. Credits constructs its members, clears 512 pointer slots, then resets line_count_ and frame_count_; the indexed form matches both mapped code spans and passes scoped byte/reference verification.
contraindications: Do not reorder members or replace them with raw storage to manipulate initialization order.
Do not blanket-replace memset: the qualified clear_tamper and energy_compute trials yielded no exact gains; zero-fill opcode similarity is only candidate-screening evidence.

Do not infer complete vtable contents, linked selection or game acceptance from constructor byte/reference equality. The Credits aggregate strict report still has unresolved generated-table/dependency evidence.
rules.reopen_when: New original store/lifetime evidence, array layout, provider/TU or compiler inputs change the causal hypothesis; a new session alone does not reopen a failed array-clear spelling.

evidence.witness: src/flatbutton.cpp and src/flatbutton.h; src/interface_assets.cpp load_interface; pinned FlatButton constructor 0x00607CF0 and close 0x00607DA0; .opensmacx/recovery/flatbutton-default-groups-nov06bf/original-data-xrefs.json; linked-current-final.json; .opensmacx/recovery/basepop-default-groups-nov06bg/outcome.json

requires: Independent consumers and producers establish logical scalar-array groups, valid element ranges and access order; contiguous addresses or a byte score alone are insufficient.
Fresh original/current instructions localize an induction-base residual to a flattened source object; prior negative trials must be qualified against the current class/lifetime shape.
All known users and producer writes are included, and historical object identities and any bounded obligations can be preserved through the native object writer.
rules.action: Test separately named typed groups instead of treating semantically distinct state groups as one flattened global array. In the measured FlatButton bundle, nine named groups of three borrowed Sprite pointers plus nine explicit copies inside the three-state loop restore both constructor and reset code; migrate the real definitions, declarations, producer and behavioral fixtures together. Preserve the first historical start with a target alias and keep additional starts unbounded when original allocations are unproved. Compare the whole affected cohort and actual application build before integrating.
contraindications: Do not publish the undefined extern-only prototype as working code or retain a flat compatibility facade.
Nine logical groups do not prove nine historical allocations, names, original TUs or complete linked data layout.
The related BasePop experiment produced no exact gains; do not propagate a source rewrite solely because another class has a 27-slot table.
Host compiler success does not prove legacy compiler acceptance; the producer's repeated loop variables required ordinary separate blocks for VC6.
rules.reopen_when: New semantic grouping, original references, source ownership, class lifetime or compiler inputs distinguish a new hypothesis; do not repeat the same flattened-array spelling trials.

evidence.witness: src/buffer.h pixel_height; pinned Buffer::init 0x005D7756-0x005D775A; FlatButton::on_redraw 0x00607E50; recovery/tests/test_flatbutton_redraw_height_actual_source.py; .opensmacx/recovery/flatbutton-default-groups-nov06bf/independent-evidence-review.json; src/pushbutton.cpp PushButton::on_redraw 0x0062C110; pinned bottom-coordinate arithmetic at 0x0062C23B-0x0062C253 and alternate state at 0x0062C4B7-0x0062C4CF; recovery/tests/test_pushbutton_redraw_height_actual_source.py

requires: The actual receiver type, subobject offset and member definition distinguish a raw stored value from a normalized accessor.
Pinned producer stores and consumer arithmetic independently establish the sign/scale convention and read timing.
rules.action: Restore the typed raw member reads where the original operates on stored representation, keeping repeated reads, signed division and operation order. FlatButton's seven formulas require negative DIB biHeight; substituting positive pixel_height reverses centered and bottom extents. Verify complete extracted source behavior with a positive-helper damage control. The same contract applies to PushButton's default/pressed nine-sprite painters: restore six raw reads in their common source body, including bottom corners and tile extents. This is a semantic restoration, not an exact-match result.
contraindications: Do not change a shared accessor to repair one caller or replace helper calls tree-wide.
A negated accessor is not inherently wrong; -pixel_height can already express raw biHeight correctly.
Names and decompiler local labels do not establish geometry; trace real draw/tile arguments and distinguish unrelated receiver types such as Font.
Do not add bounds checks, normalize error paths or claim the whole renderer exact from this semantic correction.
PickTech draw_item uses -3 - raw, algebraically equal to -3 + pixel_height(); its mismatch does not justify the same replacement.
rules.reopen_when: New producer/consumer, receiver-layout, scale/sign or callback-reread evidence changes the proven member contract.

policy: Source annotations remain the identity/claim authority; this catalogue grants no match or acceptance.
Current measurements, fingerprints, attempt counts and derived worklists belong in ignored caches; negative observations apply only to their tested inputs/hypothesis.
Use independent original evidence before adapting a sibling; similarity, ICF membership or a callee set alone is insufficient.
Test the full affected family and retain exact neighbors. Justified structural regressions require explicit review/restoration, not automatic rejection or claim demotion.
Reopen a plateau on relevant new evidence, body/header/provider/TU, recipe, compiler or image changes; a session boundary alone is not a new attempt.
A witness demonstrates a bounded case, not a universally proven code-generation rule.
